quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: SGE, GE Vernova, Hitachi and Samsung C&T sign MoU to (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MoU, not a contract: SGE, GE Vernova, Hitachi and Samsung C&T signed a Memorandum of Understanding establishing a framework for cooperation on market development and commercial opportunities for deploying the BWRX-300 small modular reactor in Central and Eastern Europe and the United Kingdom; under it the companies will assess market opportunities, develop deployment strategies and pursue commercial opportunities. It was signed in New York at the Atlantic Council Nuclear Energy Policy Summit and is linked to the U.S.-Japan-Korea Memorandum of Cooperation on SMR deployment in third countries. Roles per the release: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy (GVH), a joint venture between GE Vernova and Hitachi, is the designer and technology provider of the BWRX-300 (a 300 MW SMR; first unit already under construction in Canada); Samsung C&T brings engineering and construction (EPC) capabilities; SGE is developing a BWRX-300 fleet in Europe and remains the exclusive regional lead for the BWRX-300 in much of Central and Eastern Europe. SGE's pipeline: in Poland, Decisions in Principle have been issued for 26 BWRX-300 reactors, with current development focus on three sites that could host the first 14 units; in the UK, SGE is advancing a 4.2 GW fleet of 14 BWRX-300 reactors across three multi-unit sites, with its proposal progressing to the Preliminary Regulatory Assessment Deep Dive led by Great British Energy - Nuclear. No orders, dollar values or dates stated.
quarterly_data.figure: MoU only (no order); BWRX-300 300 MW; SGE: Decisions in Principle for 26 reactors in Poland, 4.2 GW fleet of 14 reactors proposed in the UK
